row.evidence: Fountain help centre: "SCIM is compatible with major Identity Providers including Okta, Microsoft Entra (formerly Azure AD), OneLogin, and others that support the SCIM 2.0 standard"; the pricing page redirects to a demo form to "Get pricing tailored to your customized product suite."
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans; /pricing redirects to a demo-request form. SCIM 2.0 is a self-serve toggle under Settings > Security > SCIM Provisioning and works without SSO; which contracts include it is not public. Users only (no SCIM Groups); roles and location/job/opening access go through a Fountain extension schema. Unassigning a user deactivates (soft-deletes) them. Okta uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App and Entra a non-gallery app; the Entra gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT only.

plans.name: Custom (Contact Sales)
plans.price_text: Get pricing tailored to your customized product suite.

auth.token_source: Settings > Security > SCIM Provisioning (copy SCIM Base URL and Authentication Token)

deprovision.data_retained: User is soft-deleted (marked inactive), can no longer log in, data retained for historical and compliance purposes; reassigning the user in the IdP reactivates them.

custom.how: Extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:fountain:2.0:User with role (string), externalLocationIds, externalJobIds, externalLocationGroupIds, externalOpeningIds (string arrays of Fountain IDs or exact names)

roles.how: role attribute in the Fountain extension schema; must match an existing Fountain role name, otherwise the company default role is applied

limitations.text: No SCIM Groups; user provisioning only.
SCIM-managed users cannot be edited or removed in Fountain; SCIM-synced attributes become read-only.

methods: oauth2 (Bearer, Fountain One API keys, token valid 60 minutes)

rate_limits.text: 120 requests per minute by default (X-Api-Ratelimit-* headers, HTTP 429 when exceeded).

okta.notes: No Fountain app in the OIN; Fountain tells customers to use Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token).

entra.notes: Gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT; SCIM provisioning uses a non-gallery enterprise application.

onelogin.notes: Fountain names OneLogin as a compatible SCIM IdP; no OneLogin catalogue page loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Not in the JumpCloud SSO & SCIM applications list (navigation of jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-fortinet), but absence cannot be quoted.
